title: A Deadline for the Ghost
author: Noor Dravenmoor
blurb: Jude Nakamura, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
